summary: A governor opens with shared good news the whole room can applaud, then turns to criticism of the legislature across the aisle.
realLife: Cooper's last State of the State, March 6, 2023, began with jobs and bipartisan gains, then faulted the Republican legislature on tax cuts, school funding and culture-war fights, and pressed hard for a standalone Medicaid bill.
sources: Read the news report of the address and noted the order of praise and criticism and the asks.
inGame: The `stand` and `call` sections, with the target pulled from party control of the legislature.

turns.what: The governor keeps to praise for the whole speech.
turns.pulledBy: a legislature of the governor's own party
turns.writesBack: The stand section has no criticism.

turns.what: The governor jabs once at the end and offers a joint effort.
turns.writesBack: The speech records one criticism and one invitation.
